'''Elena Ray''', also known as '''Black Manta''' due to her corporate battle tactics, was head of Research and Development at [[Shankti Drive Works]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was also secretly the leader of the [[G'uotr Network]], a criminal black market. She planned to make enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] through the Network to get herself and her associates off-planet before a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] destroyed the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system]]. She managed to control a number of hanger bays in the [[D'larah]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], as well as subvert many members of the [[D'larah City Patrol]]. When [[Demophon]] was destroyed she intended to be quite wealthy, and leader of a new criminal network.<ref name="TC" />
